root_cause.text: In the bonding driver's bond_xmit_broadcast() function, concurrent slave list mutations during RCU-protected iteration caused the racy bond_is_last_slave() check to inconsistently identify the last slave, leading to the original sk_buff being double-freed.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "Concurrent slave enslave/release can mutate the slave list during RCU-protected iteration, changing which slave is 'last' mid-loop," and the patch diff shows replacing the racy bond_is_last_slave() check with a stable index comparison (i + 1 == slaves_count) against a pre-snapshot count.

vuln_statements.explanation: This loop in bond_xmit_broadcast() contains the vulnerable RCU-protected iteration over slave devices. The bond_is_last_slave() check at line checking 'if (bond_is_last_slave(bond, slave))' is racy because concurrent slave list mutations can occur during the iteration, causing inconsistent identification of the last slave and resulting in double-free of the original sk_buff when both clone and copy paths execute incorrectly.
